title: Your answer comes first
body: Saved with its question before any review runs.
line: In Keating 4.0, your answer comes first. It's saved, with the question and the task, before any review begins.

title: Judged against the rubric
body: An independent judge, chosen apart from your tutor.
line: Then an independent judge checks it against the rubric, and the result lands beside your work, ready to inspect.

title: Flag what it missed
body: A second opinion, not the final word.
line: If the review missed something, you can flag it. A judgement is a second opinion, not the final word.

title: What to practise next
body: Recall fits checked on 288 practice states.
line: Judgements also decide what you practise next. Jev reviewed two hundred and eighty-eight practice states to tune recall and review order.

title: Every mark has a reason
body: Open any question and see why.
line: So every mark comes with a reason you can open. Keating: judgement you can check.
